newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken appoints Danish bond chief.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken appoints Danish bond chief.

text.p: Swedish bank S-E-Banken said on Thursday that it had appointed Peter Holtermand as head of bond trading in Denmark.
The bank said it expected to start bond trading in Copenhagen this summer, employing 16 people in sales, trading, micro and macro analysis.
"We are starting our Danish activities on a gradual basis during 1997, commencing with bond trading," Ralf Ence, head of S-E-Banken's Copenhagen branch, said in a statement.
"Later on this year we will be able to offer both investment banking and cash management services."
Holtermand is the former head of bond trading at Alfred Berg Bank AS in Copenhagen.
